recommendation_response.engineering_verdict: The 1-storey Residential building in Galle (Moderate Coastal Humid) is designed as a Reinforced Concrete Frame structure evaluated against SLS 614 structural load requirements. Extreme coastal saline exposure (Salinity: Extreme) requires Grade 30 dense-mix concrete with maximum w/c 0.40, silica fume addition, and epoxy-coated or stainless steel reinforcement to resist chloride-induced corrosion per SLS 690. Site exposure classified as MODERATE — structural specifications meet BS 8110 Class XS1 and all walling and roofing materials are rated for tropical humid conditions.
